quick_facts.sprint_goal: Stand up authentication + RBAC and store management — the two foundational modules that every other feature depends on.

content.tldr: Sprint 1 implementation complete. NestJS backend built with auth (JWT + Redis refresh rotation) + store management. Build passing, 11 tests green.
content.sprint_notes: Sprint 1 implementation complete. Docker Compose (6 services), NestJS backend scaffold, common layer (guards/filters/decorators), auth module (JWT + bcryptjs + Redis token rotation), stores module (CRUD + taxCode immutability + deactivation session flush), TypeORM migrations, admin seed, API contracts approved. npm build + 11 unit tests passing.

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Sprint 1 planned. Features auth + store committed. Roadmap through Sprint 3 defined.

audit.author: vibe-backend-nestjs
audit.note: Sprint 1 backend fully implemented. Auth module: JWT access (15m) + refresh (7d, Redis rotation), bcryptjs cost 12, no-enumeration 401 (BR-AUTH-08), RolesGuard, JwtAuthGuard + @Public bypass. Stores module: taxCode immutable, soft-delete, deactivate flushes Redis sessions. 2 migrations, admin seed. Build passing, 11 tests green. API contracts approved.
